description_ru: Люси хочет произвести впечатление на родителей, но всё идёт не так: индейка вместо курицы, подгоревшая картошка. Смешной разговор на кухне.
text:
Lucy: Ben, can you hear me? I need your help in the kitchen, please.
Ben: I am coming. Why are you shouting? It is only five o'clock.
Lucy: Because my parents are arriving at seven, and I have not started the dinner.
Ben: What? You said you were going to cook the whole meal yourself.
Lucy: I know, I know. I wanted to impress them. They think I am a terrible cook.
Ben: To be fair, last Christmas you made soup that tasted like soap.
Lucy: That was an accident. I used the wrong bottle. Now please help me. What can you do?
Ben: I can chop vegetables. What are we going to make?
Lucy: I decided on roast chicken with potatoes, carrots and a green salad. For dessert, an apple cake.
Ben: That is a lot of food for two hours. Did you buy everything?
Lucy: I bought the chicken, the potatoes and the carrots. I forgot the apples.
Ben: Then I will run to the shop. Anything else?
Lucy: Cream, please. And a lemon, because I want to make a sauce.
Ben: Understood. Meanwhile, put the chicken in the oven. It needs more than an hour.
Lucy: How hot should the oven be?
Ben: Look at the packet. It usually says two hundred degrees.
Lucy: Here it is. It says one hundred and eighty. And forty-five minutes per kilogram.
Ben: How heavy is the chicken?
Lucy: Two kilograms. So it needs ninety minutes. We will have to hurry.
Ben: Right. Put it in now, and I will be back in ten minutes.
Lucy: Wait! There is something wrong. This is not a chicken. It is a turkey.
Ben: A turkey? Why did you buy a turkey?
Lucy: It was cheaper than the chicken, and the man in the shop said it was better.
Ben: How big is it, exactly?
Lucy: Look at the label. It weighs five kilograms.
Ben: Five kilograms! That needs more than three hours. We do not have time for that.
Lucy: Oh no. What are we going to do?
Ben: Let us cut it into pieces. Small pieces cook faster than a whole bird.
Lucy: That is a clever idea. But I do not have a big knife.
Ben: Use the sharp one in the drawer. Be careful.
Lucy: Ouch! I hurt my finger.
Ben: Show me. It is only a small cut. Put a plaster on it, and I will do the rest.
Lucy: Thank you. You are better at this than I am.
Ben: I watch a lot of cooking programmes. Now, get me a large dish and some oil.
Lucy: Here you are. Do you want salt and pepper too?
Ben: Yes, and some garlic. Where is it?
Lucy: I think it is in the cupboard on the left. Wait, there is a strange smell in the kitchen.
Ben: It smells like something is burning. Did you leave the bread in the toaster?
Lucy: No. Oh, the potatoes! I put them on the cooker twenty minutes ago and forgot about them.
Ben: Turn off the gas! Quickly!
Lucy: Done. The pan is black, and the potatoes look like little stones.
Ben: Do not worry. We will boil new ones. I am going to the shop now, and I will buy more potatoes.
Lucy: And the apples, the cream and the lemon.
Ben: Of course. Please do not touch anything while I am away.
Lucy: I promise. Actually, wait. Can you also buy some ice cream? Just in case the cake fails.
Ben: Good thinking. I will be back in fifteen minutes.
Lucy: Ben, hurry. It is already half past five.
Ben: I am running. Do not panic!
Lucy: I am not panicking. I am only talking to the turkey.
Ben: I am back. I bought apples, cream, a lemon, potatoes and ice cream. And a box of chocolates.
Lucy: Why chocolates?
Ben: For your mother. A guest is always happier with chocolate.
Lucy: You are a genius. Now, let us make the cake. How much flour do I need?
Ben: Two hundred grams. Mix it with sugar, eggs and butter.
Lucy: Done. Now the apples. Should I cut them small or large?
Ben: Small. And put them on the top, in a circle, so it looks nice.
Lucy: It looks like a real cake. I cannot believe it.
Ben: Put it in the oven next to the turkey pieces. We have about forty minutes.
Lucy: In the meantime, I will set the table. Where are the good plates?
Ben: In the cupboard above the fridge. And please use the clean glasses, not the ones with lipstick.
Lucy: Very funny. Ben, it is a quarter to seven. They will be here soon.
Ben: Then run upstairs and change your clothes. I will finish here.
Lucy: Thank you. I do not know what I would do without you.
Ben: You would order a pizza. Now go!
Lucy: Wait. What is that sound? Someone is ringing the doorbell.
Ben: They are early! Quick, hide the burned pan under the sink.
Lucy: Done. Welcome, Mum and Dad. Come in. Dinner is almost ready, and it smells wonderful.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Долгий звук в центре рта, как «ё» без «й»; губы не округляйте, язык расслаблен, r не произносите резко.
Дифтонг: начните с широкого «а» и плавно сдвиньте губы к короткому «у».
Короткий открытый звук, близкий к ударному «а»; рот открыт средне, язык в центре.

questions.question: What time are Lucy's parents arriving?
What did Lucy buy instead of a chicken?
What does Ben buy at the shop?
questions.answer: Apples, cream, a lemon, potatoes, ice cream and chocolates.
